gaps.sentence: The witnesses gave accounts that contradicted one ___.
gaps.explanation: 'Contradict one another' is the reciprocal form used for more than two people.

gaps.sentence: She speaks English ___ than her brother.
By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: I wish I ___ told him the truth at the time.
gaps.explanation: 'wish + past perfect' for regret about the past.

gaps.sentence: The plane had no ___ taken off than the captain was forced to turn back.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner … than' is the fixed pair; here it sits after 'had'.

gaps.sentence: She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: The letter must ___ signed by both directors before it is valid.
gaps.explanation: 'Must' is followed by the bare infinitive 'be' + past participle for the passive.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ sold out by noon.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive: had been + participle (before the stated past moment).
